reason: The rule compares a default import's local name with the name of the declaration that the imported module default-exports. The port can only flag every default-import binding (the candidate set).

evidence.why: `import b from "./named.test"` is flagged because named.test.ts declares `export default a`. That is only visible in the other file
`import anyName from "./anonymous.test"` has the same syntax and is not flagged, because that module's default export is anonymous. The port reports an FP
